==Description==
'''Exposed''' is a status effect that nullifies the [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] attribute. '''Exposed''' can be applied by the [[Spotlight Tech]] after Level 2.

==Mechanics==
When applied to an enemy, it will no longer require hidden detection to be detected. Therefore, this only works on enemies with [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. Losing '''Exposed''' makes it so that they require hidden detection again if [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]].

==Enemy List==
Any enemy can have '''Exposed''' if it is in the [[Spotlight Tech]]'s spotlight.

==Tower & Unit List==
Although no known use on towers for this attribute exists, the following towers used to have '''Exposed''':
*[[Golden Snowballer]]
*[[Spotlight Tech]] (Level 2+)
